newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open unchanged to up 0.10.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open unchanged to up 0.10.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent firmer Friday, based on market orders at 1019 EDT, dealers said.
They expect the market to consolidate losses following Thursday's weak close. Support was pegged at July's lifetime low of 72.05 cents a lb.
A total of 668 notices have been issued to date, NYCE said.
Thursday, the most-active July contract ended down 1.34 cents at 72.31 cents after trading from 73.20 to 72.20 cents. New-crop December finished 0.89 cent lower at 75.05 cents.
